item.title: Donors are the Heroes - Read - CKUA
item.description: With CKUA's 2026 Spring Fundraiser just around the corner, now's a great time to shine the spotlight on CKUA's Leadership Donors. These everyday heroes donate at a level of $1000 or more before our on-air fundraising campaigns start. Their donations are used to create a pool used during specific times to match new one-time and monthly contributions. In short, Leadership Donors make Double and Triple Your Dollar Hours possible!
